title: Slot claim: signer authorization/quota model needs decision; validate_interleaved unused
description: Any pinned key-store entry can claim up to all 60 slots for its own IID; first claim never conflicts (scan sees only registered gateways); no per-gateway quota and lichen_slot_coord_validate_interleaved is never called to enforce ordinal/pattern consistency. Not a regression (pre-rewrite had the same model) and TOFU self-pinning is not mesh-reachable (key PUT is local-admin-gated), but one compromised provisioned key starves the DODAG capacity plan. Needs a spec-level decision on signer role/root-gateway authorization and quota policy (possibly human-flagged), plus calling validate_interleaved on accept.
